title: World of Warcraft Midnight 12.1 — Major Healing Cooldowns

scope.definition: Large direct healing bursts or sustained output windows. A short cooldown is not automatically excluded when its impact is large. Healing/defensive hybrids and hero-tree-dependent throughput windows are explicitly labeled.
scope.modifier_coverage: Direct named talent gates, replacements, cooldown/duration changes, and material cooldown-specific throughput interactions. Generic all-healing stats/passives, every downstream proc, equipment, racial abilities, PvP and encounter-specific resets are excluded.
scope.base_values: Spell data before optional modifiers. Talent-tree access is still required.
scope.source_policy: Official 12.1 changes take precedence for intended design; live talent membership and rank-aware data determine availability. Conflicting sources remain flagged, not silently reconciled.

field_conventions.units: Seconds unless a field explicitly states otherwise.
field_conventions.zero: An instantaneous heal has duration 0; this does not imply it has no cooldown.
field_conventions.null: No single fixed duration, an unresolved value, or a value not applicable to that field; never interpret null as zero.
field_conventions.durations: Nominal complete channel, buff, summon or HoT windows; cast time and trailing effects are separate. Realized channel timing may vary with haste, interruption or early cancellation.
field_conventions.variants: Options are conditional and not necessarily combinable. Refer to choice metadata. Null duration in a variant must not overwrite the base duration as a numeric value.
field_conventions.spell_ids: Player-facing cast/talent IDs; triggered combat-log heal IDs can differ. Treat a passive talent ID as a modifier, not a cast event.
field_conventions.dynamic_recovery: A flag indicates potential dynamic recovery within the specialization, not that every build receives it. Use named modifiers and character talents.
field_conventions.icon_file: Each cooldown.icon.file is a portable relative path from the directory containing this JSON. Its source_url preserves the Lorrgs download URL.

cooldowns.name: Tranquility
cooldowns.inclusion_reason: A sustained raid-healing channel.

modifiers.name: Flourish
modifiers.effect: Tranquility extends your existing heal-over-time effects by 2 seconds every second of the channel. Flourish is a passive modifier here, not a separate scheduled cooldown.

modifiers.name: Regenesis
modifiers.effect: Increases Tranquility healing, with a larger benefit on low-health targets. Two-rank talent; does not alter its cooldown or channel length.

notes: Use the full, uninterrupted channel as the nominal window; haste and interruptions can change realized channel time.
Inner Peace has a -30-second tooltip and appears in legacy modifier data, but is absent from the retrieved current talent tree. Do not assume a 150-second cooldown without checking the character.

cooldowns.name: Incarnation: Tree of Life
cooldowns.inclusion_reason: A long throughput window that strengthens core healing spells.

modifiers.name: Cenarius’ Guidance
modifiers.effect: Summons a Grove Guardian every 10 seconds during Tree of Life. Each fading Grove Guardian reduces its remaining cooldown by 5 seconds. Total recovery depends on guardian generation and expiry.

modifiers.name: Control of the Dream
modifiers.effect: Keeper of the Grove: time spent ready before activation is subtracted from the next cooldown, capped at 15 seconds. Choice with Power of the Dream. This is variable recovery, not a permanent cooldown reduction.

modifiers.name: Reforestation
modifiers.effect: Every fourth Swiftmend grants a separate 10-second Tree of Life proc. This does not set the manually activated ability’s duration or cooldown.

modifiers.name: Potent Enchantments
modifiers.effect: Keeper of the Grove: adds 6 seconds to the Reforestation proc (16 seconds total), not to the manual 30-second Tree of Life.

notes: Tree of Life and Convoke the Spirits occupy the same choice node.
A fixed 120-second or shorter Tree timer is not its base cooldown; actual reuse depends on the build and guardian activity.

cooldowns.name: Convoke the Spirits
cooldowns.inclusion_reason: Compresses numerous healing casts into a short burst.

modifiers.name: Cenarius’ Guidance
modifiers.effect: Halves the cooldown and reduces channel duration and spell count by 25%; also improves the chance of an exceptional spell.

modifiers.name: Control of the Dream
modifiers.effect: Keeper of the Grove: time spent ready before activation is subtracted from the next cooldown, capped at 15 seconds. Choice with Power of the Dream. This is variable recovery, not a permanent cooldown reduction.

notes: Tree of Life and Convoke are alternatives.
Control of the Dream may subtract up to a further 15 seconds on a given use; that reduction requires prior ready time.

cooldowns.name: Rewind
cooldowns.inclusion_reason: Group recovery scaled to damage recently taken.

modifiers.name: Temporal Artificer
modifiers.effect: Reduces Rewind’s cooldown by 60 seconds.

modifiers.name: Time Convergence
modifiers.effect: Chronowarden: eligible non-defensive abilities with a cooldown of at least 45 seconds grant a 15-second Intellect buff; Essence spells extend it by 1 second. This is a secondary throughput buff, not the duration of the healing spell.

notes: The damage look-back is 5 seconds; the healing-over-time effect is 4 seconds. These are different windows.
Chronowarden Temporal Burst can accelerate cooldown recovery dynamically; do not hard-code its recovery as a flat reduction.

cooldowns.name: Dream Flight
cooldowns.inclusion_reason: An initial path heal followed by a large healing-over-time effect.

modifiers.name: Inner Flame
modifiers.effect: Activating Dream Flight or Stasis adds a substantial healing-over-time bonus and increases Essence Burst generation from Living Flame/Reversion. The buff lasts 20 seconds for Dream Flight or 15 seconds for Stasis.

modifiers.name: Time Convergence
modifiers.effect: Chronowarden: eligible non-defensive abilities with a cooldown of at least 45 seconds grant a 15-second Intellect buff; Essence spells extend it by 1 second. This is a secondary throughput buff, not the duration of the healing spell.

notes: Dream Flight and Stasis are mutually exclusive.
The 15 seconds describes the heal over time, not time spent flying. Flight travel depends on distance; Trailblazer affects travel speed.

cooldowns.name: Stasis
cooldowns.inclusion_reason: Stores and replays three healing spells for a large prepared burst.

modifiers.name: Inner Flame
modifiers.effect: Activating Dream Flight or Stasis adds a substantial healing-over-time bonus and increases Essence Burst generation from Living Flame/Reversion. The buff lasts 20 seconds for Dream Flight or 15 seconds for Stasis.

modifiers.name: Time Convergence
modifiers.effect: Chronowarden: eligible non-defensive abilities with a cooldown of at least 45 seconds grant a 15-second Intellect buff; Essence spells extend it by 1 second. This is a secondary throughput buff, not the duration of the healing spell.

notes: Dream Flight and Stasis are mutually exclusive.
Stores three helpful spells; after the sequence is loaded, the release window is 30 seconds. Healing duration depends on the spells stored.
Spell data marks cooldown start after the aura fades; cooldown planners should confirm the observed release/end event rather than starting a timer from the first preparation press.

cooldowns.name: Tip the Scales — Temporal Burst build
cooldowns.inclusion_reason: Included as a major throughput window specifically when Chronowarden’s Temporal Burst is selected.

duration.label: Next empower; 30-second Temporal Burst when talented

modifiers.name: Temporal Burst
modifiers.effect: Chronowarden: Tip the Scales grants a 30-second window of decaying haste, movement speed and cooldown recovery, starting at 30%.

modifiers.name: Chronoboon
modifiers.effect: Chronowarden: reduces Tip the Scales’ cooldown by 30 seconds.

modifiers.name: Time Convergence
modifiers.effect: Chronowarden: eligible non-defensive abilities with a cooldown of at least 45 seconds grant a 15-second Intellect buff; Essence spells extend it by 1 second. This is a secondary throughput buff, not the duration of the healing spell.

notes: Without Temporal Burst, Tip the Scales is principally an instant maximum-rank empower enabler and falls below this report’s major-throughput scope.
The base effect is consumed by the next empowered spell; it is not itself a fixed 30-second healing buff.
Temporal Burst’s changing recovery rate prevents a universal effective cooldown for the Evoker kit.

cooldowns.name: Revival
cooldowns.inclusion_reason: Immediate raid healing with a broad dispel.

modifiers.name: Uplifted Spirits
modifiers.effect: Reduces Revival/Restoral cooldown by 30 seconds and increases their healing.

notes: Choice with Restoral. Revival also removes up to three Magic effects plus Poison and Disease effects.

cooldowns.name: Restoral
cooldowns.inclusion_reason: Alternative immediate raid heal, usable while stunned.

modifiers.name: Uplifted Spirits
modifiers.effect: Reduces Revival/Restoral cooldown by 30 seconds and increases their healing.

notes: Choice with Revival. Removes Poison and Disease; does not perform Revival’s Magic dispel.

icon.mapping_note: Lorrgs groups this spell under the parent record and uses that record’s icon. It is intentionally shared, not a missing download.

cooldowns.name: Invoke Yu’lon, the Jade Serpent
cooldowns.inclusion_reason: A sustained celestial healing window with cheaper Enveloping Mist.

modifiers.name: Gift of the Celestials
modifiers.effect: Reduces the summon cooldown by 60 seconds and sets its duration to 12 seconds. Choice with Jade Bond.

modifiers.name: Jade Bond
modifiers.effect: Alternative to Gift of the Celestials. Strengthens the celestial’s healing; expiring/consumed Chi Cocoons apply 4 seconds of Enveloping Mist. Current version does not reduce the summon cooldown.

modifiers.name: Celestial Harmony
modifiers.effect: Adds 10-second Chi Cocoons to five allies on invocation, plus a celestial-specific benefit to Teachings of the Monastery or Enveloping Mist.

modifiers.name: Restore Balance
modifiers.effect: Conduit of the Celestials: increases healing while either celestial is active. Choice with Yu’lon’s Knowledge.

modifiers.name: Courage of the White Tiger
modifiers.effect: Conduit of the Celestials: invoking either celestial guarantees the next eligible Tiger Palm, Vivify or Sheilun’s Gift triggers the White Tiger effect.

notes: Choice with Invoke Chi-Ji.
The summon lasts 25 seconds baseline. The separate 4.5-second Soothing Breath effect is not Yu’lon’s summon duration.

cooldowns.inclusion_reason: A melee-driven healing window with stronger access to Enveloping Mist.

modifiers.name: Gift of the Celestials
modifiers.effect: Reduces the summon cooldown by 60 seconds and sets its duration to 12 seconds. Choice with Jade Bond.

modifiers.name: Jade Bond
modifiers.effect: Alternative to Gift of the Celestials. Strengthens the celestial’s healing; expiring/consumed Chi Cocoons apply 4 seconds of Enveloping Mist. Current version does not reduce the summon cooldown.

cooldowns.name: Celestial Conduit
cooldowns.inclusion_reason: A major group-healing channel exclusive to Conduit of the Celestials.

modifiers.name: Unity Within
modifiers.effect: Can be activated once during the channel to call all four celestials at increased effectiveness; triggers automatically at the end if unused. It is part of this cooldown, not a separate scheduled cooldown.

modifiers.name: Path of the Falling Star
modifiers.effect: Raises Celestial Conduit output most strongly when healing fewer targets.

modifiers.name: Jade Sanctuary
modifiers.effect: Adds immediate self-healing and damage reduction during the channel and for 8 seconds after it ends. Choice with Niuzao’s Protection.

modifiers.name: Chi-Ji’s Swiftness
modifiers.effect: Increases movement speed during the channel; subsequent celestial assistance adds a short movement buff.

notes: Movement is allowed; casting another healing or damaging spell cancels the channel.
No fixed cooldown-reduction talent for Celestial Conduit was established in the current tree. The pet cooldown reductions do not apply to this ability.

cooldowns.inclusion_reason: A primary sustained healing-throughput window.

static_variants.label: Sanctified Wrath; no Call of the Righteous
Call of the Righteous rank 1
static_variants.notes: Cooldown from rank-aware tree; effective duration unresolved.

modifiers.name: Call of the Righteous

modifiers.name: Walk Into Light

modifiers.name: Born in Sunlight

cooldowns.name: Divine Toll
cooldowns.inclusion_reason: An impactful multi-target Holy Shock burst; included despite its shorter cooldown.

modifiers.name: Quickened Invocation
modifiers.effect: Reduces Divine Toll’s cooldown by 15 seconds for Holy. Choice with Divine Resonance.

modifiers.name: Divine Resonance
modifiers.effect: Alternative to Quickened Invocation: adds automatic Holy Shocks every 5 seconds for 15 seconds. This extends the healing sequence, not the initial instant cast.

modifiers.name: Dawnlight
modifiers.effect: Herald of the Sun: empowers the next two Holy Power spenders to apply an 8-second Dawnlight heal-over-time effect.

modifiers.name: Aurora
modifiers.effect: Herald of the Sun: grants a free, stronger Holy Power spender after Divine Toll.

modifiers.name: Ringing of the Heavens
modifiers.effect: Aura Mastery triggers a separate Divine Toll at increased effectiveness. This does not establish a shorter cooldown for the manually cast Divine Toll.

notes: Choice with Holy Prism. Divine Resonance and Quickened Invocation cannot be selected together.

cooldowns.name: Aura Mastery
cooldowns.inclusion_reason: A major raid defensive with direct healing-throughput additions when talented.

modifiers.name: Unwavering Spirit
modifiers.effect: Reduces Aura Mastery’s cooldown by 30 seconds. Choice with Protection of Tyr.

modifiers.name: Protection of Tyr
modifiers.effect: Adds increased healing received for affected allies during Aura Mastery. Choice with Unwavering Spirit.

modifiers.name: Ringing of the Heavens
modifiers.effect: On activation, casts Divine Toll at 200% effectiveness.

notes: Without Protection of Tyr or Ringing of the Heavens, this is principally damage mitigation/utility rather than healing throughput.

cooldowns.name: Evangelism
cooldowns.inclusion_reason: An empowered Radiance plus two instant follow-up Radiances supports a major healing ramp.

duration.label: Instant initial heal + 2 charges; 18-second Archangel or 12-second Mindbender

modifiers.name: Archangel
modifiers.effect: Adds 18 seconds of increased healing and absorption. Choice with Mindbender.

modifiers.name: Mindbender
modifiers.effect: Alternative to Archangel: summons a Mindbender for 12 seconds when Evangelism is used. This is not an additional manual cooldown.

modifiers.name: Inescapable Torment
modifiers.effect: When using the Mindbender branch, eligible spells trigger extra pet attacks and extend its life. Extension depends on actual casts.

notes: Current Evangelism is not the old flat Atonement-extension button. Its core effect is an immediate empowered Radiance and two charges consumed by later Radiance casts.
Do not assign Archangel’s 18 seconds to builds using the alternative Mindbender talent.

cooldowns.name: Ultimate Penitence
cooldowns.inclusion_reason: A large Penance-bolt barrage used directly for healing or through Atonement.

modifiers.name: Void Infusion
modifiers.effect: Voidweaver: improves Atonement transfer from the Penance family during Entropic Rift; relevant to offensive Ultimate Penitence sequencing. Does not change the base cooldown.

notes: Has a 1.5-second nominal initial cast before the 6-second healing/damage sequence.
Choice with Power Word: Barrier. Barrier is mitigation, so it is not another throughput entry.
Legacy Heaven’s Wrath/Overloaded with Light cooldown-reduction claims were not supported by the current talent tree and are not applied.

cooldowns.name: Divine Hymn
cooldowns.inclusion_reason: A raid-healing channel that also increases subsequent healing received.

modifiers.name: Seraphic Crescendo
modifiers.effect: Reduces Divine Hymn’s cooldown by 60 seconds. Choice with Gales of Song.

modifiers.name: Gales of Song
modifiers.effect: Alternative to Seraphic Crescendo: distributes Prayer of Mending stacks each second during the channel.

modifiers.name: Benediction
modifiers.effect: The relevant Apex effect adds a Cosmic Ripple to each Divine Hymn pulse.

notes: Each pulse applies/refreshes a 15-second stacking healing-received buff. That trailing buff is separate from the 5-second channel.
The current channel is 5 seconds, not the 8 seconds retained by some trackers.

cooldowns.name: Apotheosis
cooldowns.inclusion_reason: A high-output Holy Word window with greatly improved access to Holy Words.

modifiers.name: Eternal Sanctity
modifiers.effect: Adds 12 seconds, giving a 32-second base window. Choice with Divinity.

modifiers.name: Divinity
modifiers.effect: Alternative to Eternal Sanctity: adds healing during Apotheosis and empowers the next three Prayers of Healing.

modifiers.name: Perfected Form
modifiers.effect: Archon: increases healing during Apotheosis.

modifiers.name: Sustained Potency
modifiers.effect: Archon: each created Halo extends Apotheosis by 1 second; up to 6 seconds can be stored while it is inactive. Also pauses its duration during certain downtime, up to 20 seconds. Choice with Energy Compression.

notes: Sustained Potency makes the total window variable. Do not assume 20 or 32 seconds is always the final observed length.
Older Answered Prayers/Divine Word advice was not used as evidence of current additional cooldowns.

cooldowns.inclusion_reason: Archon turns Halo into a substantial multi-wave group-healing event.

modifiers.name: Divine Halo

modifiers.name: Energy Compression

modifiers.name: Manifested Power

modifiers.name: Voice of Harmony

Nominal cast time is 1.5 seconds. With Power Surge the emission window spans 10 seconds, but the final returning wave can heal later.

modifiers.effect: Reduces Ascendance or Healing Tide Totem cooldown by 60 seconds. Choice with Preeminence.

modifiers.name: Preeminence
modifiers.effect: Alternative to First Ascendant: adds 3 seconds to Ascendance/Healing Tide Totem and grants haste while active.

modifiers.name: Oversurge
modifiers.effect: Totemic: increases Surging Totem output while Ascendance or Healing Tide Totem is active. The generic tooltip mixes specialization effects; no numeric healing coefficient is asserted here.

modifiers.name: Deeply Rooted Elements
modifiers.effect: Riptide can trigger a separate 6-second Ascendance proc. This does not reduce the manual ability’s cooldown and is not independently schedulable.

notes: Ascendance and Healing Tide Totem are alternatives in the current tree.
First Ascendant and Preeminence are also alternatives; a 120-second cooldown plus 18-second base duration is not a valid combination of those talents.

cooldowns.name: Spirit Link Totem
cooldowns.inclusion_reason: Major group stabilization through redistribution and mitigation; adds direct burst healing with Spouting Spirits.

modifiers.name: Spouting Spirits

modifiers.name: Lively Totems

unresolved_issues.summary: Holy Paladin duration values disagree across current public sources. Do not silently select one as a measured live value.

evidence.claim: 12.1 notes specify duration penalties of 3 seconds per rank for Avenging Wrath and 2 seconds per rank for Avenging Crusader.
Two-rank calculator description instead retains penalties of 4/8 seconds for Wrath and 2.5/5 seconds for Crusader; cooldown reductions are 15/30 and 7.5/15 seconds respectively.
Generic tooltip presents a different flattened set of values and is unsuitable for rank-aware planning.

unresolved_issues.resolution: Keep effective talented duration null until a live 12.1 character confirms the rank effects and the ordering with Sanctified Wrath.

unresolved_issues.summary: Inner Peace is absent from the retrieved current talent tree, although its spell record and legacy modifier mapping remain.

evidence.claim: No selectable Inner Peace node was found for Restoration; the modifier map still references it.
The surviving spell tooltip reduces Tranquility cooldown by 30 seconds.
Tracker lists Tranquility at 150 seconds, without proving current talent availability.

unresolved_issues.resolution: Use the 180-second unmodified base; only enable the 150-second variant after checking current character talent availability.

excluded_from_primary_catalogue.reason: Major mitigation, but no direct group-healing throughput; outside the requested throughput list. Barrier also competes with Ultimate Penitence.
Single-target protection, healing amplification or emergency rescue, rather than a group-healing throughput cooldown. Worth tracking separately for tank/external assignments.
Current spell is a PvP talent and is absent from the retrieved PvE tree; Lorrgs retaining it does not establish PvE availability.
Mana, cooldown support or external haste rather than a direct group-healing cooldown.
Regular rotational, short-cycle, or foundational healing tools; excluded to keep this a major-cooldown catalogue.
Relevant current passives, triggered effects, alternative branches or sub-actions are documented under their parent cooldown instead of being counted as additional independent buttons.
